status: Technical correction verified; Ember review and owner acceptance pending

method.baseline: Isolated Git archive of rejected commit, port 5261; eight circle/corner diagnostic replays, not successful editor strokes.
method.environment: Windows development machine, Chromium desktop 1440x950, hardware WebGL2 and forced Canvas, one browser worker; mobile regression is Pixel 7 emulation, not physical hardware.
method.gesture: 900 trusted native CDP mouse moves at fixed 60 Hz for 15 seconds, plus initial down and release. Explicit matched 200 m strength; 45 km radius. Four motions: broad curve/reversal, repeated circle, physical edge, circular travel across all three corner faces.
method.timing: Original native event timestamp through canonical commit and actually displayed epoch. All per-dab timing records collected, including early records beyond the 240-record diagnostic ring. Each reported quantile belongs to one case; ranges are not pooled percentiles.
method.pixelProbe: Actual terrain canvas copied to 128x128: first visible change, then 100 ms sampling. Excludes HTML cursor/outline. Instrumentation overhead remains included. Every-frame probe/profile measurements were excluded because readback itself consumed about 3.3 seconds of a 15-second hold.
method.releaseBacklog: Elapsed browser time from native release to idle observation, excluding the explicit 120 ms post-idle delay; includes polling/observation overhead. Failed-baseline release numbers are not successful full-stroke drain times.
method.correctness: All 16 corrected cases completed every admitted input, pending admission zero, exact whole-gesture Undo/Redo by canonical-word SHA256, three repeated Lower gestures, no recovery/error. Native events can coalesce; each coalesced sample reaches the established 3-screen-pixel admission policy, with terminal release included. Smaller observations accumulate to the next admitted point: 451-901 admitted points per case; no accepted input is dropped.
method.limits: Development-machine measurements are not a universal latency guarantee. Finite counts, exact-work, history memory, and representability safeguards remain. Maximum-radius brushes can still be expensive.

validation.horizontalDrag: Desktop and mobile emulation: surface follows left/right dragging, original up/down behavior retained, canonical hash unchanged; included in 34 cube regressions.

bounds.phaseError: m * spacing / 2^65 for m route segments, plus separately certified nearest/even chart rounding
